description: Read a GST invoice (PDF, scan or photo): number, date, seller and buyer GSTINs, place of supply, HSN codes, taxable value, CGST, SGST, IGST, total and amount in words, and check them against each other and the GST rules.

file.description: The file, base64-encoded (a data: URL also works). Up to 5 MB.

lang.description: OCR languages joined by +, such as eng+hin. Default eng.

ocr.description: PDF: auto (default) uses OCR only when the PDF has no text.

name: read_gst_invoice
title: Read gst invoice
